title: Fulfillment Destination
description: A buyer-visible fulfillment destination, discriminated by destination_type: a postal address (shipping, local delivery), a retail location (pickup, curbside), a locker, or a pickup point. Legacy payloads without destination_type remain valid: they resolve as a postal address, or as a retail location when id and name are present.

postal_address_destination.title: Postal Address Destination
postal_address_destination.description: A postal address destination, used by shipping and local delivery. An object carrying a name is never a postal address destination; this keeps the arms of the oneOf disjoint for legacy payloads without destination_type.

id.description: ID specific to this destination. Required at use sites that reference destinations by selected_destination_id.

destination_type.description: Discriminator for a postal address destination.

retail_location_destination.title: Retail Location Destination
retail_location_destination.description: A retail location destination, used by pickup and curbside. destination_type SHOULD be included; it is optional only for backward compatibility with payloads that predate the discriminator.

destination_type.description: Discriminator for a retail location destination.

locker_destination.title: Locker Destination
locker_destination.description: A self-service locker destination for pickup. Shares the retail location structure; destination_type is required. When location_type is also present it SHOULD agree with destination_type.

pickup_point_destination.title: Pickup Point Destination
pickup_point_destination.description: A third-party pickup point destination, such as a service counter in a partner store. Shares the retail location structure; destination_type is required. When location_type is also present it SHOULD agree with destination_type.

destination_type.description: Discriminator for a pickup point destination.
